Definition: to lead astray, i.e. (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce
BiblicalUsage: 1) to beguile, deceive; 1a) (Niphal) to be beguiled; 1b) (Hiphil) to beguile, deceive; 1c) (Qal) utterly (infinitive)
